License choice

Source: LICENSE-CHOICE.md

The project license is GNU AGPL version 3 only (AGPL-3.0-only; R package metadata uses AGPL-3 + file LICENSE). This is a strong copyleft license: distribution of modified versions carries source and same-license obligations. Section 13 adds a network-use provision: users interacting with a modified version remotely must be offered its Corresponding Source.

Comparison

  • MIT is permissive. It allows reuse, modification, and distribution, subject mainly to retaining the copyright and permission notices.
  • Apache-2.0 is also permissive, with express patent terms and requirements to preserve notices and mark changes.
  • GPLv3 uses strong copyleft for conveyed copies and modified versions. It does not add AGPLv3’s specific network-interaction source offer.
  • AGPLv3 builds on GPLv3 and adds that source offer for users interacting remotely with a modified version.

This comparison summarizes license terms, not legal advice. Prior easyNIS releases published under MIT remain licensed under the MIT grant for those versions; this change applies to this project version and later versions.
